_comment: Massachusetts 2025-2026 QAP (EOHLC). Two scoring stages: Section XI-A Fundamental Project Characteristics (100 points, gated) and Section XI-B Special Project Characteristics. Page numbers are PHYSICAL PDF pages; the printed page number runs two lower.

qap_updates.notes: TWO-STAGE SCORING. Section XI-A awards 100 points across five equally weighted components (20 each) and acts as a gate: an application must score at least 12 in EVERY component, and at least 60 overall, or it receives no allocation and is never evaluated for Section XI-B. Section XI-B then awards up to 85 further points. stated_total = 100 refers to XI-A only; the QAP states no combined maximum.

criteria.heading: Financial feasibility
criteria.note: 20 points available, 12-point minimum required. Falling below 12 in this component alone disqualifies the application entirely.

criteria.heading: Fundamental design characteristics
criteria.note: 20 points available, 12-point minimum required. Revised in this QAP to emphasise green, carbon-reducing and climate-resilient design, including continuous mechanical ventilation.

criteria.heading: Contribution to a concerted community revitalization planning effort
criteria.quote: Contribution to a Concerted Community Revitalization Planning Effort

criteria.heading: MBE/WBE membership on the development team
criteria.quote: MBE/WBE Membership on the Development Team

criteria.heading: Persons with disabilities or special populations as intended consumers
criteria.quote: Persons with Disabilities or Special Populations as Intended Consumers
criteria.note: Awarded to projects offering units for people with disabilities integrated into larger projects, at no more than 15% of total units.

criteria.heading: Location in an area of opportunity
criteria.quote: Location in an Area of Opportunity
criteria.note: The largest single item in Section XI-B.

criteria.heading: Rural LIHTC projects
criteria.note: REVIEW: B-6 (area of opportunity) and B-7 (rural) are likely to be mutually exclusive in practice, but the QAP does not say so. Not grouped, pending review.

criteria.heading: Green, carbon-reducing, sustainable and climate resilient design
criteria.quote: Emphasis on Green, Carbon-Reducing, Sustainable, and Climate Resilient Design

tiers.tier_label: Clean energy systems, incl. on-site solar photovoltaic

criteria.note: Stated as '21 Maximum Additional Points' — the largest item in either MA scoring stage. Sub-components are spread across three pages; only the Clean Energy Systems sub-cap (4) was read cleanly, so the tier list is incomplete and the 21-point maximum is the reliable figure.

criteria.heading: Minimum 12 points in every fundamental component, and at least 60 overall
criteria.quote: must score at least 12 points in each of the
criteria.note: A scored gate rather than a conventional threshold: an application scoring under 12 in any one component receives no allocation and is not evaluated for Section XI-B at all.

track_totals.note: Section XI-A states 100 points across five components of 20 each.
Section XI-B states no maximum; the eleven items sum to 85.
